name: ride_id
description: Trip id assigned by Citi Bike.

name: started_at
description: Trip start, UTC (source: New York wall-clock time).

name: ended_at
description: Trip end, UTC (source: New York wall-clock time).

name: start_station_name
description: Start station name; null for some dockless electric trips.

name: start_station_id
description: Start station id (a string: e.g. 6182.02, JC024).

name: end_station_name
description: End station name; null when the bike was not returned to a station.

name: member_casual
description: member (annual subscriber) or casual (single ride or day pass).

name: source_month
description: First day of the month of the file the trip came from (partition column).

name: source_file
description: CSV file inside the monthly ZIP the trip came from.
